data.name: 独鸢恋章-Floral Ink from Hibiscus
data.detailed_description:
welcome to qq group：1053240826

Character：

Gu Wanying

She is a talented literary girl who hopes to write her own romance novel, but for her who is new to love, this task is too difficult. But if it was Jin yeying in front of her, maybe she would be inspired.

Jin yeying

She is a poor girl who longs to be the most important person to others, but no one does this in real life. The neglect in daily life, such as she is always the last one to be left behind when grouping, makes her no longer have any expectations for it. But if it was Gu Wanying in front of her, maybe it can fill the gap she has been missing for last few years.

Wild Lily

She is a lovely wild lily, she will appear in various places in the game, go and try to find her!
